<div style="margin:0 5px">Offline gains allow players to continue generating resources while not actively playing. Offline progression '''<u>simulates</u>''' normal gameplay systems but applies several modifiers and behavioral differences compared to active (online) play.<br>
Offline rewards are therefore a '''reduced simulation of gameplay''', not passive rewards granted independently of normal mechanics.</div></div>

== Offline Penalties ==
The following global multipliers apply during offline progression:

{| class="wikitable sticky-header align-center-2"
! System !! Offline Multiplier
|-
| Ore Income || x0.92
|-
| Bar Output || x0.92<ref>Offline bars are only generated by Transmuter Bomb, which also depends on ore gain, so both modifiers effectively stack giving .92² = approximately 85% total bar gain penalty.</ref>
|-
| All Star Multiplier || x0.85<ref>Without CTRL+F, Star gain becomes '''1/5 (20%)''' of its 0.85x offline value</ref>
|-
| Vein Income || x0.85
|}
The gains are capped to 12h of simulated gameplay, or 24h with [[Founder]].
<references />

==Chest Meters==
Both Chest Meters do not progress at all during offline. Instead, 0.3 Item Chests and 0.1 Relic Chests are gained per hour offline. This rate can be doubled with the [[Skill-Tree#Chronokeeper|Chronokeeper Skill]].
If the Offline Period does not result in a full Chest of the respective type, they get randomly rounded.
Example: 1 Hour offline time without Chronokeeper has a 30% chance to give one Item Chest and 70% chance to give none.

== Elixir Buffs ==
Elixir buffs function during offline progression.

They are not applied separately when rewards are claimed. Instead:

* Elixir buffs are embedded directly into production calculations.
* Offline simulation treats buffs exactly as they would behave during online play.
* Buff effects are assumed active throughout the simulated period.

=== '''Buff Uptime Requirement''' ===
To build or maintain stacked elixir effects:

* Buff generation must exceed '''100% uptime'''.

=== Critical Effects ===
During offline progression, critical bonuses are applied using their expected value rather than random rolls. 

For example, a 10% chance to deal 3× results in an effective '''1.2×''' multiplier to uptime. 

<math>1 + p(m - 1)</math>

== Star Gains ==
Star gain functions during offline progression but includes an additional conditional penalty.

=== Star Following Requirement ===
If the player is '''not following the star''', offline star gains are further reduced:

* Star gain becomes '''1/5 (20%)''' of its normal offline value.

To avoid this penalty, the player must:

# Unlock the skill '''[[Skill-Tree|CTRL+F]]'''
# Actively '''follow the star''' before going offline (note: to get full gains, the star must be followed even if the star is fixed in place using [[Stargazing#Wish|Wish]])

=== Offline Star Mechanic ===
Each Star has 5 different floors which it can spawn on, see [[Stargazing#Star Floors|below]]. Stars do not move between floors while offline. You can use this to keep a Star on a floor by closing the game just before Stars move to new floors, then reopening it immediately after they would have moved.

Gaining stars offline behaves differently depending on if you have the Skill [[Skill-Tree#Skills|Ctrl+F 'Stars']] unlocked and are following a star (Option 1), or if you don't use Ctrl+F Stars following (Option 2).<br>
You can follow a Star by either clicking the "follow" button in the Stargazing menu or by clicking the Star indicator below the Relic Chest Meter, which appears when you are on a floor which currently has a Star on it.

Option 1:<br>
If you follow a Star and then exit the game, you will gain only the Star you followed using this formula:<br>
<math>\text{Gained Stars} = \text{Spawned Stars} \times \text{Autocatch Chance} \times (\frac{Star Floors Unlocked}{5})</math><br>
You do not gain any other Stars which share the same spawn floor. If a star can appear on floors you haven't yet unlocked (for example, Orion is split between World 2 and World 3 floors), you won't get those floors' fractions of the star income (reflected above in the "Star Floors Unlocked / 5" segment.

Option 2:<br>
Exit the game while on a floor where a Star can spawn on. It does not matter if a Star is currently on this floor. When you come back online, you will gain all Stars which can spawn on this floor. Each Star uses this formula to calculate how many you gain:<br>
<math>\text{Gained Stars} = \text{Spawned Stars} \times \text{Autocatch Chance} \times \frac{1}{5}</math><br>
The 1/5 multiplier in this formula exists to represent the 5 different floors the Star could move to.

In any case, your offline gains will be based on the floor you went offline on, e.g., if you go offline on a floor that has ores that can only be damaged by super crits, your clear rate will suffer as if you had stayed on that floor for the entirety of your offline time.<br>
Boosts to spawn rates, autocatch, and other stats from temporary buffs and fueled [[Drones#Drone Fuel|Drones]] will apply to your offline gains if you enable them when you log back on.

== Offline Drop Threshold Behavior ==
Offline progression can slightly benefit extremely rare drops such as cards or shards.

All offline progress for a given card or shard is taken as a lump, and a single RNG roll is made at increased odds based on that. For example, if a drop chance is '''1:25000''', and you collect 10000 of the relevant resource while offline, it makes a single roll at 10000:25000 odds (2:5, or 40% chance of success). If you collect 25000 while offline, the roll has a 100% chance of success, guaranteeing a drop.

This protects you against unlucky streaks that could otherwise delay a shard drop for a long time (like pet levels…), but it does mean that if you collect ''more'' than the odds, the excess is wasted, as you can only earn one at a time with this method.

== Auto-Bomber vs Drones ==
Offline bombs always hit before drones.
